text:
jin: Rolling canary to ~7% in eu-west now. deploy-bot pushed release v2.3.1-rc4 at 11:05. Calling stop/go — need ops + infra signoff.
pat: Saw a tiny bump in embed-service 5xxs ~11:12, +0.3% overall. Not yet alarming but flagged.
maya: Looking at traces — root cause looks like a slow tokenizer path on long prompts; qps for that shard doubled briefly.
tara: @pat @maya can you paste the minimal log snippet? also, how's kv-cache hit rate? we warmed caches in the pre-bake.
pat: log snippet:
```
2026-03-22T11:12:07Z embed-srv ERROR: tokenizer timeout (350ms) id=abc123 path=/v1/embed
stack: call tokenize -> normalize -> read-model
```
kv hit rate: 88% on primary, dropped to 62% during the spike
deploy-bot: DeployBot: v2.3.1-rc4 -> traffic 7% (eu-west). Autoscale: enabled. Canary window started 11:05 UTC.
jin: kv drop could explain the tail. We had a cold shard on one host, probably a network hiccup.
maya: I can push a hotfix to limiter config — reduce max-parallel-tokenize on that pool from 12 -> 8. Cheap mitigation, no rollback.
tara: What's the fallback plan if we keep seeing tail latency? rollback to v2.3.0 pinned is quick. Does anyone object to trying the limiter tweak and observing 10m?
pat: No objection. If errors trend >0.8% for 5min we rollback. Also request a pin to v2.3.0 in case we need fast rollback (pat -> ops-ticket created).
jin: Agree. I'll hold off expanding traffic until we see 10m of stable telemetry. Can we delay further ramp to 15%? want an extra 10m buffer.
maya: Applying limiter tweak now to euro-token-pool. Pushing config: `kubectl apply -f token-limiter-eu.yaml` (done)
pat: Seeing immediate drop in tail calls to tokenizer host, kv hit rising back to 84% within 90s.
tara: Nice. Let's hold for 10m. @deploy-bot leave traffic at 7% and don't auto-increase.
deploy-bot: DeployBot: traffic growth paused per manual flag. Auto-increase disabled for canary v2.3.1-rc4.
jin: Ok we keep status: HOLD. If steady for 10m -> GO to 15%. If error spike returns, we ROLLBACK to v2.3.0 (pat to run pin).
maya: Noted. I'll prepare the rollback playbook steps just in case (dbus pinned, cache flush sequence documented).
pat: ops-ticket: OPS-4472 created to pin and coordinate rollback. link: https://redwood.internal/ops/OPS-4472
tara: Release notes: https://confluence.redwood/relnotes/v2.3.1-rc4 (minor infra change + tokenizer tuning)
jin: Thanks everyone — HOLD for now. Re-check at 11:18 for final GO/ROLLBACK call. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
pat: +1
maya: +1 :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: System note: canary window will auto-expire in 2h if left paused. Manual intervention required to resume after expiry.
